gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Stretched wide and cut at a single width, Tourney looks like a scoreboard. Noto Sans Old Persian is the plain sans underneath, with tall lowercase and open curves that let the white space in, so the heading shouts and the body speaks.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Tourney spreads its bulky little letters out wide, with no hairlines anywhere to thin out. Noto Sans Old Sogdian follows with a tall x-height and wide mouths, so paragraphs stay crisp and friendly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Tourney stretches its heavy, uniform strokes across the line like a jersey number, never thinning anywhere. Noto Sans Old Turkic matches that muscle with chunky, tall lowercase.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Smooth as drawn wire and wide as a stadium banner, Tourney leads while Noto Sans Oriya follows with generous curves and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Shrink the heading and its stretched, bulky shapes lose their punch.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-osage: Tourney is all plain, unshaded lines, spaced wide and built with oversized small letters that look ready for a race. It excels at announcing, while Noto Sans Osage, a plain sans, excels at inflated, sweeping lowercase that keeps its curves open.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Wide, loud and unvarying in line thickness, Tourney looks like it came off a locker-room wall. Noto Sans Osmanya then takes over with easy s turns and lowercase that towers beside its own capitals, giving the sans a relaxed footing.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Tourney holds one constant stroke width across wide-tracked, bulky letters, which gives it real athletic punch. Noto Sans Palmyrene is the quieter specialist, with curves that stop short and compressed ascenders.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Tourney is built for impact, with joins as thick as its strokes and words stretched wide across the line. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau, a modern sans, does the gentler work, with open-ended curves and capitals only a short step above the lowercase.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa is the quiet one in this pairing, with c openings you can see through and a gentle bump up to capitals. And Tourney, bulky and wide with curves that never thin at the turns, handles the loud part.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Wide, bulky and built like a sports banner. Noto Sans Phoenician sits underneath with generous lowercase height and s curves that open at both ends, so a sans paragraph feels easygoing from top to bottom.
